Reduces the cooldown of your Summon Gargoyle by 60 sec.

While your Gargoyle is active, Grave Coil commands it to fire Gargoyle's Wrath at your target.


 Gargoyle's Wrath
Deals 120 Plague damage and chains to nearby enemies.

Increases the damage done by your Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard's melee attacks, your Imp's Firebolt and the Firebolt of your Wild Imps by 35%. 

Increases the critical strike chance of your Hand of Gul'dan by 15%.

Fire, Frost and Nature damage done increased by 9% while under the effects of Shamanistic Rage. 

Increases all party and raid members' attack power by 10%.

Dealing damage with Thrash and Lacerate has a 10% chance to grant you Ursine Frenzy.


 Ursine Frenzy
Increases the damage of Mangle (Bear) by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 5 sec.

While Ursine Frenzy is active Mangle (Bear) has no cooldown and generates more stacks, but will not extend the duration.

Dealing damage with your Shadow Priest damage over time spells or healing with Shadow Mend generates a stack of Vampiric Essence. 

Mind Flay generates 2 stacks per tick. 

Each tick of Mind Sear can consume 3 Vampiric Essence to heal up to 5 allies for 200 health.

Shadow Word: Death consumes your Vampiric Touch on the target, dealing Shadow damage equal to 100% of its total damage. This is increased to 220% if Shadow Word: Death critically strikes.

Shadow Word: Death's self-inflicted damage is reduced by 60%.
records.name: Vampiric Death

Requires  Path of Healing
Your Vampiric Embrace healing now scales with Healing Power and heals the lowest-health ally in your party or raid. It no longer provides additional healing to you.
records.name: Vampirism

records.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shadowfiend ability by 120 sec and of your Fade ability by 6 sec.

Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.

Gives you a 3% bonus to Physical and Holy damage you deal after dealing a direct critical strike. 

Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 30 seconds.

Critical strikes with Slam, Overpower or Mortal Strike against a bleeding target afflict them with Venomous Wound.

 Venomous Wound
Target takes 75% more damage from your Instant Poison. Holds 3 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

Dealing damage with Victory Rush reduces Last Stands cooldown by 10 sec. 

Using Last Stand grants one use of Victory Rush, which will further reduce its cooldown by 35 sec.

records.description: Increases your maximum Energy by 20.

Increases the damage dealt by your poisons and Envenom ability by 20%.

Gives your damage over time poisons an additional 30% chance to resist dispel effects.

Increases your hit chance by 3%.

Reduces the chance that your damage over time diseases can be cured by 30%.

Mind Blast, Mind Flay and Mind Sear spells cost 15% less mana.

Capstone Bonus: Your Mind Blast extends the duration of Void Eruption by up to 3 seconds and your Mind Flay ticks increase the periodic damage increase of Void Eruption by an additional 3%, stacks up to 10 times.

Shadow spells increase the damage of your combo point generating Rogue abilities by 3% and Dark Intent by additional 3%. Stacks up to 3. 

Rogue combo point generating abilities have a chance to increase the damage taken from your Shadow Word: Pain by 80% for 8 sec.

Your Haunt applies Waking Nightmare to the target. When that target is healed, the healer is afflicted with Phantom Nightmare.

 Phantom Nightmare
You deal 10% increased Shadow damage to the target. Fear effects last 50% longer against them.
records.name: Waking Nightmare

Dealing periodic damage with Moonfire grants you Waning Moon. 
 Waning Moon
Reduces the cast time of your next Arcane Blast or Starfire by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.

Whenever one of your attacks is dodged or blocked you have a 50% chance to gain 2% critical strike chance for 8 sec, stacks up to 3 times. 

Reduces the duration of all Disarm effects used against you by 30%.

Dealing damage with Whirlwind now grants you Bloodrage.
It also grants you Enrage if known.

Dealing damage with Shadow Word: Pain now has a 35% chance to summon a Tentacle of the Old Gods to wreak havoc on your enemies. 

Each Tentacle summoned increases the damage of your Grasp of Darkness by 15% and its critical strike damage bonus by 15%.
records.name: Whispers of the Old Gods

Dealing damage with Mongoose Bite or Savage Blade now restores 40 energy and grants you Wild Aggression.

 Wild Aggression
Increases the damage of your Rogue abilities by 15%. Lasts 8 sec.

 Wild Wrath
Your next Wrath has a 34% reduced cast time and 10% increased damage. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 12 sec.

If cast at 3 stacks, Wrath refreshes Insect Swarm and resets the cooldown of Chimera Shot.

records.description:
Maul has a 12% chance to grant you Wildclaw.


 Wildclaw
Your next Bloodthirst deals 125% increased damage, hits 3 additional targets, and generates 100% increased threat.

Dealing damage with Stormstrike reduces the cooldown of Whirlwind by 2 seconds.

Dealing damage with Whirlwind reduces the cooldown of Stormstrike by 2 seconds.

Dealing damage with Windfury grants you Wind Slam

 Wind Slam
Your next Shield Slam or Shield of Righteousness slams nearby targets with wind, dealing 19 Physical damage and slowing their attack speed by 20% for 30 sec.
records.name: Wind Slam

Increases your critical strike chance by 3%. 

Direct Frost damage has a 100% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect: Increasing the chance spells will critically strike the target by 1% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.
records.name: Winter's Chill

records.description:
Chains of Ice brands the target with Winter's Lock.


 Winter's Lock
Increases Frost damage you deal to this target by 5%. Lasts 15 sec.
records.name: Winter's Lock

Your Wrath now afflicts enemies affected by your Haunt or Blood Plague with Wrath of the Plague.


 Wrath of the Plague
Disease the enemy, dealing 3 Shadow damage every 0.5 sec for 2.27 sec.

This damage can critically strike.

records.name: Wrath of the Sun

Feral finishing moves now have a 20% chance per combo point spent to grant you Wrathful Strikes.

 Wrathful Strikes
Your next Wrath can be cast in Cat Form, is instant, and deals 25% increased damage.
records.name: Wrathful Strikes

Dealing damage with Windfury grants you Wrath of Al'Akir.

 Wrath of Al'Akir
Increases your chance to trigger Windfury by 2% and your melee attack speed by 1%.

While at max stacks, your next Windfury hits 2 additional times and consumes all stacks. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 15 sec.
